json.reason: The fix enforces a project contract: db.query() must receive a tenant scope option, otherwise the query returns rows from other tenants. A single-argument db.query() call is detectable from syntax alone.
json.title: db.query() called without tenant scope
json.message: db.query() called without a tenant scope option: this query can return rows from other tenants
json.note: Queries issued through db.query() must be scoped to the current tenant; with only the SQL argument the query returns rows belonging to every tenant. Pass the scope as the second argument, e.g. db.query(sql, { tenantId }).
